Name: Bridge Solutions
Description:
Wist jij dat je door 20% van je processen te automatiseren, wel 80% tijd en geld kunt besparen?

In de praktijk zijn het vaak 20% van de processen die voor 80% onnodige tijd, kosten en frustratie zorgen. Maar dan moet je natuurlijk wel weten welke processen dit zijn. Op dit moment heerst er veel ‘fear of missing out’ bij MKB Nederland als het gaat om AI. De nieuwe aanbieders, tools en cursussen vliegen je om de oren en al snel zie je door de automatiserende bomen het robotachtige bos niet meer. Toch wil je zo snel mogelijk iets met AI doen, want de concurrent is er ook al mee bezig!

Het gevolg? Voor je het weet ben je nóg meer tijd en geld kwijt, door je op de verkeerde processen te focussen. En het probleem van tijdrovende, frustrerende, inefficiënte processen is nog steeds niet opgelost.

Wij zijn geen voorstander van ‘iets met AI doen om maar iets met AI te doen’. Voordat we ook maar iets gaan automatiseren, gaan we eerst in gesprek met verschillende partijen binnen jouw bedrijf om erachter te komen welke processen nou eigenlijk het probleem vormen. Die routinematige processen die tijd en geld opslurpen alsof het water is, en erger nog: het plezier uit het werk halen voor jou en je medewerkers. Juist die processen willen we automatiseren. Zodat jij en je team weer kunnen focussen op het werk dat jullie liever doen, én waar jullie beter in zijn.

Description:
Wij zijn een innovatieve startup, opgericht eind 2019, met ondersteuning van het innovatiefonds Smart City Dordrecht. 

Optimz smart monitoring software is een universeel platform en een veelzijdig alternatief voor bestaande SCADA systemen binnen de (afval)waterbranche. Optimz is een webbased applicatie die zich vooral kenmerkt met “slim-snel-visueel” monitoren, voorspellen, analyseren en besturen van rioolgemalen.

Gemeente en waterschappen krijgen bij gebruik van Optimz smart monitoring software meer inzicht in hun rioleringssysteem met minder inspanning. Onnodige schade en uitval wordt voorkomen, onderhoudskosten en werkdruk worden verlaagd en energieverspilling en milieuschade wordt geëlimineerd.

Voor onze inzichten en aanbevelingen kijken we o.a. naar het gedrag van geclusterde gemalen binnen een bemalingsgebied en naar het individueel functioneren van pompen, rekening houdend met externe factoren zoals neerslag. De stroomopname van de pomp is één van de belangrijke indicator om de conditie van een pomp te bepalen. Middels de ondersteuning van kunstmatige intelligentie en specifieke triggers wordt deze data omgezet naar concrete aanbevelingen en alarmen. 

Door het voorspellen van noodzakelijk onderhoud kunnen periodieke inspecties worden gereduceerd en vakmensen gericht en geautomatiseerd worden ingezet. Dit hele proces van melding tot herstel wordt gemonitord en gerapporteerd conform contractuele afspraken met leveranciers op het gebied van prestatie en kwaliteit. 

Wij streven er naar om elk type sensor, meet en besturingssysteem te connecteren en de vertaalslag te maken van (big)data naar concrete aanbevelingen. Optimz is ontwikkeld voor de (afval)waterbranche, maar inmiddels ook interessant voor andere markten. Mede door de slimme database structuur en de modulaire opbouw van ons platform kan er eenvoudig worden ingespeeld op de wensen van de klant.

Our systems combine AI, IoT sensors, advanced filtration, and electrochemical engineering to monitor water quality in real time from TDS and microbes to heavy metals and usage patterns. Additionally, the CEA and RAS units generate nutrient-rich outputs for consumption, maximizing the value derived from every drop of purified water. The integrated system combining RO, RAS, and CEA technologies is known as the Autonomous Aquatic Nutrient Generator (AANG).

From smart consumer RO containers to institutional stations and city-scale infrastructure, Das AquaVita offers a modular and scalable ecosystem.

Headquartered at WaterCampus Leeuwarden, we operate at the intersection of water science and deep tech, supported by global R&D partnerships across Europe, India, Japan , UK, USA ,Australia and Southeast Asia.

Das AquaVita also leads the Axolotl Conservation & Digital-Twin Habitat Program, using IoT, genomic screening, XR, and citizen science to restore endangered aquatic species and create a blueprint for global aquatic conservation.

Our mission is to deploy 1000+ smart water nodes by 2030, building a real-time global water-data grid that supports public health, ESG goals, and climate resilience.

Why do we do the things we do?

What makes our clock tick, here at iStill, is that we love to bash the status quo. In everything we do, we believe that challenging the existing state of affairs is the way to move forward. We believe in thinking outside the box and in doing things differently.

How do we do that?

What we do?

We design, build, and sell revolutionary distillation, fermentation, and mashing equipment for the Craft Distiller.

Where we are situated?

iStills are designed, produced, assembled, and tested in the Netherlands, near the city of Amsterdam. The Netherlands is Europe’s most competitive and innovative economy. Worldwide it is ranked 4th overall (source: WEF). Designing and producing in the Netherlands gives iStill access to some of the best trained and most innovative workforce the world has to offer; a major competitive asset.

How that benefits our customers?

By bringing Craft Distilling into the 21st century, we are able to provide our customers with equipment that outperforms anything else. Both in versatility, in overall performance and spirit quality. And in lower running costs, and better warranty terms and service.

Do you want to know more about our customers and how we service them?

We have over 600 customers. They can be found on all continents safe Antarctica. In 2017 the iStill Factory produces 200 distilleries. 2018 will see a 50% increase: we expand our production capacity to 300 distilleries.

At the iStill University, we train 200 distillers in the noble arts of advanced distilling. That is 200 distillers per year.

At the iStill Laboratory, we help our customers design the best spirits in the world. Per year, iStill helps develop over a hundred spirits. Gins, vodkas, rums, whiskies, brandies and a variety of liqueurs and specialties.

Description:
EdingCNC develops a PC Based CNC solution which is suited for many CNC applications. Eding CNC has 25+ years experience in motion hardware, software and motion applications. To be able to do this, real-time behavior at micro-second level  is required.
So the product EdingCNC is designed from the ground up to work with an external CPU which takes care of this real-time behavior.

The user interface of EdingCNC is designed with people that work with CNC machines every day. All machine operations can be done from one screen using functions keys, no mouse required. New functions will be added continuously. Also the hardware development is an ongoing process towards more functionality and higher speeds. We have two solutions regarding connection between the motion CPU and the PC; USB and Ethernet.
We recommend Ethernet for industrial usage.

The product has very professional  motion functionality with Look Ahead Feed. A price that is in range of hobbyists.
The goal is to have a product portfolio with products for starter, advanced and industrial usage.
Most important for EdingCNC are the customers, every customer gets help as long as needed until he is happy.

Name: Habeload Lifting Solutions
Description:
Habeload BV advices the industry in general in the field of hanldling matters and sells the customized solutions. For instance, how must 300kg roles be placed on spindles of machines in order to prevent operators to be fysically overloaded and to improve the efficiency of the production simultaneously? How can boxes be transferred from A to B and replaces by empty boxes so that it can be filled by the output of a productionmachine in time?

For all these kind of questions we aim at offering a customized solution and we do that in close cooperation with our sistercompany Hecas Techniek BV. 
Hecas Techniek namely developes the neccessory concept solutions, assembles the suitable machines, installs the machines on site, put them into operation and executes the service and repair.

In developing the solution a close cooperation arises not only with Hecas Techniek but also with our clients. 

At first we analyse thoroughly the handling- and production process. At that stage an intensive exchange of information between Habeload/Hecas Techniek and our customers arises and forms the input of the engineeringsproces. The first concepts are discussed and only after mutual approval we continue the engineering until we have a suitable solution. .

We service a diversity of markets such as the packaging industry, the building industry, various distribution centres, the market for personal care etc, in both the Netherlands and in western Europe.

We service our markets by a broad range of products/services such as manipulators for  weights upto 500kg (brandnames like IPS and MLS), lifting units in railsystems (weights upto 500kg and brandnames like HML, HPL, VLS, HWS) and suplementing equipment like jib cranes and lifting tables.

Name: Tyre Performance Technology
Description:
Extracting the most performance from a tyre is a time and energy consuming practice that would cost a lot of money and often has great risks involved. 
TPT developed a novel tyre compound testing method, called the TPT001 compound testing method, that makes us able to create tyre compound wear models.

These models show the change in performance of the tyre compound during its life. These models can be used as stand alone models, or they can be added to existing models like Pacejka models to include the change of performance of the tyre compound for more precise simulations and modelling.

Some tyres allow for performance gains under the right circumstances. The parameters or these gains can be found through the TPT001tyre compound testing method.
Preparing a set of tyres using these parameters can increase tyre grip with a few percent for a short period, for example for a qualifying run.

TPT offers tyre testing, model correlation testing, support and advice.

Get the most out of your tyres

Name: Scarabee Logistic Systems

PRESS RELEASE 

30-th March 2015: Merger AGVE AB and SCARABEE LOGISTIC SYSTEMS 

Sweden based AGVE, one of the pioneers of Automated Guided Vehicles and SCARABEE Logistic Systems, system integrator with offices in the Netherlands and in Germany, announce their merger. The companies will operate under the name AGVE and employ over 50 dedicated highly skilled engineers. 

AGVE was one of the pioneers of AGV technology in the 1980’s and has ever since been developing and manufacturing AGV hardware, software and vehicles. Featuring an installed base of over 2.500 vehicles in almost every European country and some big customers in Asia and the USA, AGVE has become one of the larger AGV suppliers. 

SCARABEE Logistic Systems has been a system integrator since 1987 realizing highly automated logistic systems like High Bay Warehouses, Sorter systems and AGV systems and providing full service for these systems during their operational life time.

Both companies will continue the ongoing projects, aftermarket contracts and quotations as usual. All offices, productions sites and employees will stay within the group.  
SCARABEE’s existing fine project and service organisation fits perfectly with AGVE's vehicle manufacturing and software development divisions. Through this merger, AGVE can offer the market a one-stop- shop for AGV systems: design the logistical concept, build the AGV‘s, implement them at the customer’s site and service them
their entire life time.

Having own AGV production and development allows AGVE to respond to the request we received in the past years from the market:  high quality and short delivery time at a competitive price.

The AGVE group is present across the world with offices in the Europe the USA and South Korea.  

For more information, see: www.agvegroup.com

Name: MVTec Software
Description:
MVTec Software GmbH is a leading international manufacturer of software for machine vision. MVTec products are used in a wide range of industries, such as semiconductor and electronics manufacturing, battery production, agriculture and food, as well as logistics. They enable applications like surface inspection, optical quality control, robot guidance, identification, measurement, classification, and more. Software by MVTec facilitates new automation solutions for the Industrial Internet of Things by providing modern technologies like 3D vision, deep learning, and embedded vision. With its headquarters in Munich (Germany), locations 7 locations worldwide, as well as an established network of international sales partners, MVTec is represented in more than 35 countries worldwide.
	
Products: MVTec is the developer and vendor of the standard machine vision software products HALCON and MERLIC as well as the Deep Learning Tool. 

MVTec HALCON is optimized for the needs of OEMs and system integrators and allows engineers to set up their own solutions for a specific machine vision task.

MVTec MERLIC is a powerful no-code machine vision software that enables users to quickly build complete solutions intuitively and without programming.

The MVTec Deep Learning Tool is a comprehensive software tool for preparing image data and supporting data-driven workflows for the deployment of deep-learning-based machine vision applications.

Solutions: Furthermore, MVTec builds customized software solutions for machine vision – from consultancy, studies, and prototypes up to integrated products. Software solutions can be based on standard PC or embedded hardware (e.g., Arm-based systems). Moreover, MVTec’s team has an excellent background in processing images of different kinds, including 3D, infrared, hyperspectral, and X-ray images.

Name: Bronkhorst
Description:
Bronkhorst is a leading manufacturer of Mass Flow and Pressure Meters / Controllers for gases and liquids. The worldwide Bronkhorst organisation has its Headquarters in Ruurlo, The Netherlands, and subsidiary offices in Veenendaal (NL), the UK, France, Switzerland, northern Germany, the USA, India, Japan, Singapore, Taiwan, South Korea and China, whereby local expertise and service is offered. The worldwide success of Bronkhorst is based on the fundamentals: customer satisfaction, innovation and quality. Bronkhorst is accredited ISO-9001 and ISO-14001 for quality resp. environmental management.In 2010 the company opened an in-house calibration centre accredited by the Accreditation Council (scope K127) to perform ISO 17025 certifications.

Product range:
Bronkhorst offers numerous styles of both standard and bespoke thermal mass flow meters/controllers for applications in laboratory, machinery, industrial and hazardous areas. The measuring range for these instruments can be selected between 0-1 mln/min and 0-10000 m3n/h for gases and 0-75 mg/h up to 0-20 kg/h for liquids. Furthermore Bronkhorst offers pressure transducers and controllers with a minimum range of 0-100 mbar and a maximum range of 0-400 bar. Bronkhorst's low-flow Coriolis Mass Flow Meters/Controllers for gases and liquids have a measurement capability between 0,05-5 g/h and 6-600 kg/h. The new Bronkhorst ES-FLOW is designed to measure tiny liquid volume flows (from 2 to 1500 ml/min) using an innovative ultrasonic waves principle. Fast and accurate dosing of small flow rates of e.g. additives is realized by using the flowmeters in combination with control valves or low-flow (gear) pumps.

Description:

Name: Qimarox
Description:
About Qimarox
Qimarox is a leading manufacturer of high-quality components for material handling and intralogistics systems. The company specializes in the development and production of vertical conveyors, vertical sorters, as well as pallet handling and palletising modules.
With a strong focus on innovation, reliability, and efficiency, Qimarox delivers smart, modular solutions that help customers optimize their logistics processes and reduce operational costs. The company’s forward-thinking approach and commitment to quality ensure long-lasting performance and maximum added value for OEMs and system integrators worldwide.
History
Qimarox originated from Nedpack, founded in 1995. From the outset, Nedpack focused on the design and manufacture of palletisers and vertical conveyors.
Today, Nedpack supplies a wide range of components to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and system integrators across the globe. Key examples include the Prorunner mk1 product elevator, the Prorunner mk5 vertical conveyor, and the Highrunner mk7 palletiser module. These product lines will continue to expand in the coming years.
Qimarox components are widely used in production and end-of-line packaging systems, particularly in the food industry, but also in many other sectors. In addition, product elevators have gained significant traction in warehouses and distribution centres as automation continues to grow.
In 2012, the Components Division was separated from Nedpack and established as Qimarox. While Nedpack now focuses on the design, integration, service, and maintenance of complete end-of-line packaging systems—primarily in the Netherlands—Qimarox is fully dedicated to the development and production of key components for OEMs and system integrators worldwide.

Name: Cordis SUITE
Description:
Cordis SUITE is an intelligent low-code platform that transforms machines into intelligent systems which stay adaptable, safe, and efficient over decades. It turns rigid control software into systems that evolve with you. 

By focusing only on defining the correct behaviour in a clear low-code model, you create the foundation. Everything else, from control logic and structured data to dashboards, documentation, and recipes, comes built in.

Most control software is developed once, but machines operate in the field for more than 20 years. That is where the real value lies: fewer errors, easier maintenance, faster adaptation to new products, and instant access to structured data and dashboards. Cordis SUITE is designed for this reality.

With Cordis SUITE, the low-code model becomes the single source of truth. It is always easy to interpret, even decades later, allowing software engineers, system architects, and process experts to collaborate directly. Because the model is vendor agnostic, hardware platforms can evolve without redesigning the architecture, giving you clarity instead of complexity and freedom from vendor lock in.

Recipes run safely inside the controller and can be configured per product or scenario. Operators and process engineers can adapt behaviour without touching code, keeping flexibility where it matters most. Over decades of operation, this reduces downtime, simplifies validation, and makes machines easier to evolve.

Proven for more than 25 years in industries such as high-tech equipment, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, food processing, and smart buildings, Cordis SUITE supports PLCs and embedded controllers from Siemens, Beckhoff, Rockwell, Bosch Rexroth, Mitsubishi, Weidmüller, and more.

From our offices in Eindhoven and Málaga, we help manufacturers build intelligent, self-adaptive machines that are ready for the future.

Descaling and cleaning of wire surfaces and improving the wire quality.

Batch sizes are becoming smaller, lead times shorter. Likewise, pricing pressures are increasing as are requirements for wire quality. The results of alternative techniques and devices to clean the wire by bending and brushing, blasting, scalping or even by chemical treatment are totally inadequate.

The ECOCLEAN series meets highest demands. Wire surfaces are cleaned, polished and smoothed – the wire becomes stress-relieved, its structure more consistent. Furthermore, the ECOCLEAN system provides an optimal wire material for further processing. In particular, the subsequent surface coating is made easier and the materials used in these operations are reduced significantly.

By the use of rotary cleaning heads the very universal ECOCLEAN system allows the production of clean wire at its highest level. The users benefit from wire of best quality and a very high system availability due to longevity of the cleaning heads and low wear of the overall system. Numerous options allow custom-tailored configurations of the machine for maximum productivity in manufacturing. Economic efficiency and quality are top priorities of modern wire production.

The ECOCLEAN system offers the ideal basis to manufacture high-quality wire environmentally friendly and cost efficient at maximum productivity. The ECOCLEAN series ensures success and opens up new opportunities in the market.

Name: Control-Care || Compressor Controls
Description:
The Antisurge Control Application (ACA) designed and developed by Control-Care Systems, protects your centrifugal or axial compressor from experiencing surges efficiently and reliably. Control-Care’s method of accurately defining the surge line over a wide range of changing conditions allows you to set the control safety line for optimum surge protection without unnecessary recycling or blow-off.  The controller provides fully-integrated multi-loop, multiple-body compressor antisurge control on a hardware independent platform (PLC or DCS).

Our flexible Antisurge control configuration capabilities cover all types of centrifugal and axial turbocompressors. From integrally geared packaged compressor units to multiple cases, multiple sections or side-loads in any type of process environment. The entire compressor train control scheme can include compressor performance and antisurge control, loadbalancing optimization, steam turbine speed control, gas turbine fuelcontrol, compressor and turbine auxiliaries sequencing, parametric diagnostics and ESD system interfacing.

Our ACA application helps you to effectively protect your turbo compressor from surge during start-up conditions as well as during (ab)normal operation with minimal recycle or blow-off.

Name: Cortex Glass
Description:

Our AI-driven camera systems combine high speed infrared imaging, real-time analytics, and smart process control to help glass plants increase yield, improve container quality, save energy, and reduce waste — fully aligned with Industry 4.0 / Smart Factory principles.

Our Systems

GobWatch – Monitors the entire gob forming process, controls gob weight, detects inclusions (seeds, bubbles, stones, cords), and rejects defective gobs immediately after the IS-machine.

BlankWatch – Utilizes thermal and high-speed cameras at each section to measure gob loading and the temperatures of key forming components such as the blank mold, plunger, and neck ring, ensuring optimal thermal balance and consistent forming performance.

ISWatch – Uses infrared cameras and AI neural networks to inspect every hot bottle leaving the IS-machine. It analyzes glass distribution, temperature, symmetry, verticality, and dimensions, while rejecting defects like bird swings, fins, stones, blisters, wedge bottoms, and spikes.

TopWatch – Captures top-view infrared images of hot bottles to inspect the bottle bottom for defects such as spikes, stuck glass, and other irregularities. The system also measures bottle position and rotation, automatically rejecting any misaligned, stuck, or fallen ware.

FinishWatch – Focused on the bottle finish area, detecting finish defects that could lead to sealing and closure problems. 

Each system features an intuitive touchscreen interface and provides live production data stored in local or centralized databases, enabling traceability, optimization, and remote monitoring.

Our mission is to empower glass manufacturers with real-time process intelligence, enabling faster decisions, higher efficiency, and a new level of Hot End inspection and control.

Name: SICK Accerion B.V.
Description:
Industry challenge 
Effective indoor navigation is a challenge for mobile robotics and autonomous vehicles. GPS does not work indoors, alternative systems don’t support accurate positioning or rely on expensive and inflexible infrastructure such as rails, beacons or magnet grids.

Accurate positioning without infrastructure
Accerion has developed a breakthrough, patent-pending positioning technology which can be integrated into automated vehicles and mobile robots. Our module uniquely enables automated vehicles to navigate in dynamic environments, both indoors and outdoors, without requiring infrastructure outside the vehicle or robot. 

We provide a positioning module as a single system for integration in new and existing equipment. This module enables manufacturers of robots and automatic vehicles to create new flexible and cost-effective logistics solutions. These solutions will drive automation and efficiency in warehousing, manufacturing and many other industries.

Our benefits 
No infrastructure required - Accurate positioning for robots and vehicles without infrastructure
Simple - Accurate positioning data from a single source.
Flexible - Navigation in dynamic environments, supports arbitrary routes and requires no environment preparation
Cost effective -No infrastructure means fast integration and routing setup.

Een gedeelde liefde voor techniek. Van de werkvloer tot de directiekamer: wij spreken dezelfde taal. Dat maakt samenwerken vanzelfsprekend én doeltreffend.

Bij EXPRO is techniek geen doel op zich, maar een middel om grenzen te verleggen. Samen maken we het verschil – met hoofd én hart.

Electrical engineering – ook wel hardware engineering genoemd – is één van de twee pijlers onder de dienstverlening van EXPRO engineering. Onze engineers zijn experts op het gebied van ontwerpen en verbeteren van elektrotechnische en besturingsinstallaties en instrumentatie, in allerlei verschillende industrieën en branches.

De software engineers van EXPRO engineering ontwerpen, programmeren en implementeren de besturingssoftware voor veel verschillende installaties in de industriële automatisering. Onze expertise ligt hierbij op PLC, SCADA en MES, waarbij onze engineers ervaring hebben met veel voorkomende softwaresystemen.

Name: Climotion
Description:
Climotion offers a complete service regarding the design and realization of a BaOpt installation, and is most of all a center of knowledge for advisors, installers, and measure- and control technology companies. 

Air treatment and ventilation fulfill a constantly increasing role in creating an excellent working- and living environment. Good air treatment ensures comfort, but also contributes to the energetic performance of a building.

With conventional air treatment, a directed stream is generated which then arduously mingles both the supplied air with the present air. High constant airstreams are necessary to ensure the functioning of the system, which is far from comfortable. Inconsistent temperature distribution, polluted air spaces and - most-hated by building users- a cold draft, are infamous problems. More than half of all Dutch offices cause complaints from users about the working climate. 

The solution is as simple as effective. Instead of a directed air stream, the BaOpt system manages an undirected stream that perfectly blends together the supplied air and the air within the environment. Warmth below the ceiling or cold above the floor no longer exist: the entire space contains both the same quality and temperature, eliminating any form of directed air streams and thus gets rid of cold drafts. 

BaOpt control ends poor working environments and is applicable on a much broader scale. Museums use BaOpt to ensure an optimal condition for their collections, horticulturists use it to improve growth conditions for their vegetables, professional ice skaters for the best ice and better lap times. The best of BaOpt is that it also saves a lot of energy: we transport less air and make better use of supplied air, reducing energy usage with at least 25%.

Description:
Infra-SCADA biedt standaard SCADA- en Telemetrieoplossingen van Lacroix-Sofrel. Het zijn oplossingen die wereldwijd worden toegepast. Ze zijn uitontwikkeld, versimpeld, gestandaardiseerd en beproefd. Hierdoor is het mogelijk om als (eind)gebruiker een hoge mate van zelfredzaamheid te bereiken, zonder tussenkomst van specialisten.

De LT dataloggers zijn ontworpen om afvalwater en regenwater te monitoren, bijvoorbeeld in bergbezinkbassins en bij overstorten. Ze zijn robuust, volledig waterdicht, voorzien van een batterij met 10 jaar levensduur en een GPRS modem met een high performance antenne voor gebruik in onder een putdeksel of betondek.

Uitgangspunt bij de producten van Sofrel is dat de installatie door de eindgebruiker zelf kan worden verzorgd, zonder tussenkomst van specialisten. Dit stelt hoge eisen aan zowel de gebruiksvriendelijkheid als de kwaliteit. Daarnaast moet het ‘IT-gedeelte’ dermate eenvoudig zijn dat dit niet moeilijker is dan bijvoorbeeld het installeren van een nieuwe printer. De LT-US pakt een aantal problemen anders aan. Zo wordt er gebruik gemaakt van een ultrasone sensor die in het mangat gemonteerd kan worden en niet meer in aanraking komt met het vuile water. De LT-US beschikt over een speciale antenne waardoor deze ook in onder de putdeksel functioneert. Mantelbuizen en externe kastjes in de berm behoren hierdoor tot het verleden.

De LT-US laat zich eenvoudig installeren en Infra-SCADA kan de installatie desgewenst voor u verzorgen. Mocht u daarnaast behoefte hebben aan volledige zekerheid over data en kosten, informeert u dan over de mogelijkheden.

Name: Particle Deposition Monitor
Description:
Take control of particle deposition measurements.
Surface cleanliness is crucial in cleanroom environments, high-tech manufacturing, and aerospace assembly. Yet for too long, the focus has been on airborne particles rather than what actually settles on surfaces. Deposited particles, especially larger ones, can severely compromise product quality and harm the Throughput. In even the most controlled environments, particle deposition occurs daily due to human activity and operating machinery.

Historically, assessing particle deposition meant time-consuming microscopic examination of witness plates. The Particle Deposition Monitor changes that. The PDM is a measurement system that images the surface of a glass witness plate, detecting, sizing, and counting every deposited particle down to 5 μm, including fibers. With a precision and efficiency that manual inspection simply cannot match.

What the PDM delivers:
• Particle detection from 5 μm, including fibers.
• Large ~50 cm2 detector surface for rapid, accurate results.
• Passive long-term monitoring & real-time measurement modes.
• Non-destructive analysis, samples can be re-evaluated or sent for further examination.
• ISO 14644-17:2021 compliant.
• Remote recalibration, minimising downtime.

The PDM is trusted company’s as ASML, Philips, ESA, Canon, Teledyne and SRON. 
Available for purchase, leasing or rental worldwide.

Name: PLC support India | plcsupport.in
Description:
About plcsupport.in
Aging PLCs are becoming a real headache for industries that rely on them. Often they are part of equipment that is supposed to last for several decades. When they break down they are difficult to replace. The key to countering these risks is getting access to specialized knowledge.

PLCsupport.in guarantees that knowledge. Matching you or your service provider with the right expert is what plcsupport.in is setting out to do. We maintain a network of qualified PLC experts from all over the world. 

 What's New?
We’ve recently started offering additional support to our customers who might not be as technically savvy. If you need some support, simply contact us using the web chat function on your homepage and you’ll immediately be connected to one of our Technical Support Representatives. All our TSRs are equipped with a technical background and extensive experience to help you navigate our maintenance system.

Our technical experts will swiftly diagnose your issue using intuitive questions and utilising Google Meet to gain faster visibility of your system. If it’s something a little more difficult, you’ll be passed to one of our many experts who specialise in the area you’re struggling with.

 The Benefits:
• Reduce downtime, fast access to the right support.
• Online support: sustainable, COVID-proof, and traceable.
• A supplement for the weaker and less used knowledge areas in your department.
• An opportunity to outsource the rare specialist knowledge.
• No costs for expensive service contracts.
• Support for your obsolete legacy system.
• Extend the lifetime for obsolete systems until the moment it suits you.

 Which Brands Do We Support:
We support both the legacy, obsolete PLC control systems but also the newest systems of all PLC brands like: ABB, Siemens, Allen-Bradley, Schneider Electrics, GE, Honeywell, Emerson, Mitsubishi, Omron, Hitachi, Toshiba, Yokogawa, Koyo, Delta, Panasonic, Red Lion, Bosch.

Still a great deal of analysis is required to deal with fault conditions, communication and human machine interaction.
All the wiring is done (including hall sensors, optical sensors, motors, displays digital and analogue i/o).
All a student needs to do is download the licence free software to begin programming or simulating at home.
Descriptions, manuals, i/o tables and programming tips are all freely available on the website along with the tasks and teacher guides.

Elke vestiging heeft haar eigen specialisatie en sommige zijn al meer dan 100 jaar actief op het gebied van aandrijftechniek. 

In de loop der jaren is ELSTO van een traditioneel mechanisch aandrijfhuis uitgegroeid tot een totaaloplosser op het gebied van aandrijf- en besturingstechniek. De verkoop van standaard elektromechanische componenten is aangevuld met de ontwikkeling van geavanceerde totaaloplossingen. Voor projecten waarvoor jarenlange kennis en ervaring, goede faciliteiten en een hoogwaardig productenpakket noodzakelijk zijn is ELSTO uw partner bij uitstek.

Name: KienIA Industriële Automatisering
Description:
KienIA zoekt de beste industriële automatiseerders van Nederland en zij die dat willen worden.

KienIA heeft veel te bieden.
A.	Mooie projecten en een organisatie die je vrijheid geeft en (onder-)steunt.
B.	Werken in een groep vakmensen die als doel heeft de beste te worden in haar vak.
C.	Een bedrijf dat werkt op basis van vertrouwen en waarbij ook plezier maken belangrijk is.
D.	10% van je tijd om te werken aan het verbeteren van het vak en jezelf.

A. Mooie projecten en een organisatie die je ondersteunt.
Je werkt bij ons voor klanten zoals gemeenten, Rijkswaterstaat, bouwbedrijven, waterbedrijven, waterschappen en energiebedrijven. Je helpt hen met het automatiseren van een enkele brug tot en met het automatiseren van de gehele drinkwatervoorziening van een provincie. Waar nodig regelen we een mentor of een coach, maar je zal niet snel horen dat we denken dat je iets niet kan. En als je het vraagt, komen we met z’n allen helpen.

B. Ambitieuze vakmensen
Je zal je verbazen over de kwaliteit van je collega’s bij KienIA. We willen veel van jou leren en gaan ervan uit dat we jou ook veel zullen leren. 

C. Een bedrijf dat werkt op basis van vertrouwen, met plezier in je werk
Bij ons geen middeleeuwse verlofbriefjes, verlammende hiërarchie of procedures ter bevrediging van het management. Ons ‘management’ zijn gewoon collega’s die naast je zitten en meewerken op projecten. 

Geld is belangrijk om een prettig leven te leiden, maar is niet onze primaire drijfveer. We willen graag iets toevoegen aan een betere wereld, onszelf ontplooien en samen met collega vakbroeders werken aan interessante projecten. 

D. Ruimte om te leren
Structureel mag je 10% van je tijd besteden aan het ontwikkelen van jezelf, ons bedrijf en het vak IA. Daarnaast hebben we een opleidings- en traineeprogramma. Er zijn maar heel weinig bedrijven die zoveel investeren in jouw ontwikkeling. Om kennisdeling nog meer te bevorderen is iedereen vrijdag op kantoor.

Description:

Het meedenken met de klanten in voornamelijk de recyclingsbranche heeft ook geresulteerd in het ontwikkelen van een aantal unieke producten. En we zijn nog steeds bezig met innovatie: we blijven zoeken naar manieren om nog beter te automatiseren en de efficiency en winstgevendheid nog verder te vergroten.

Enthousiasme, gedrevenheid, vakkennis en de wil om oplossingen te bedenken hebben ons gebracht waar we nu zijn: in een mooi nieuw pand in Veenendaal met ruim 30 medewerkers.
We krijgen dagelijks het vertrouwen van onze klanten – en dat maken we dagelijks waar. Als u ook wilt ervaren wat deze Duim-manier-van-werken inhoudt, neem dan contact met ons op.
